nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.qc.embed
=============================

.. py:module:: nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.qc.embed

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   HTML embedding helpers for portability (single-file reports).



Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.qc.embed.escape_srcdoc
   nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.qc.embed.iframe_srcdoc


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: escape_srcdoc(text: str) -> str

   Escape HTML so it can be placed inside an iframe ``srcdoc="..."`` attribute.


.. py:function:: iframe_srcdoc(html_text: str, *, height_px: int = 420, title: str = 'embedded') -> str

   Embed *html_text* as a self-contained ``<iframe srcdoc="...">`` at the given height, for
   portable single-file QC reports.
